pairs.difference: B: the witch hat's cone and brim fall into one near-solid black shape against a two-step orange background, and the only break is the pale buckle. Its contrast (0.198) and hero-background gap (-0.408) both fall outside the real range. A: the cap is also dark, but its top keeps a mid-dark plane, and the gold trim and tassel step up through the greys. A's gap is only slightly past the real limit.
pairs.fix: Lift the hat from black to a soft charcoal plum. Show a clear lighter top plane on the cone and brim, with a gentle fade into shadow under the brim. Keep true black only in a thin line beneath the brim.

pairs.difference: A: the cauldron body is a large pure-black mass with one small hot spot on the belly, and the near-white bubbles and flame sit hard against it. The gap (-0.246) is at the real limit. B: the gloves sit in mid to dark greys with broad soft highlights and black only in the creases and under the gloves. B's corners are lighter than its centre (vignette -0.103, outside the real range), which is why confidence stays moderate.
pairs.fix: Paint the cauldron as dark grey iron, not black, with a broad soft sheen across the belly that fades gradually. Keep the deepest dark to the inner rim and the shadow under the pot.

pairs.difference: B: the card sits almost entirely in two neighbouring mid greys. The handle is the same value as the wavy background, and only the white straw head stands out. Contrast is 0.066, below the real range. A: the scarf reads as a solid dark shape on a lighter swirl, with a small black accent inside the neck loop and a clear light medallion.
pairs.fix: Give the broom a darker handle and a deeper shadow side on the bristles and binding. Darken the blue background slightly around it so the whole broom reads as a separate shape.

pairs.difference: A: a white envelope on mid-green with darkened corners, a light-hero design. Its gap of 0.139 only just passes the real limit. B: a mid-dark wheel on a pale sky with a light ray burst behind it, inside every real range. Both have clear value groups and controlled dark accents, so nothing on this vector separates them.

A: the card is low key, with a near-black purple background of two dark steps. The white candles and metal highlights stand out hard against it. Mean lightness (0.492) and gap (0.245) are both outside the real range. B: the lamp sits on a mid to light ray burst with a soft glow behind it. Its corners are a little too dark (0.144), but the key matches real cards.
pairs.fix: Raise the purple background to a bright, saturated mid value with lighter rays at the centre. Soften the highlights on the gold so the candlestick no longer looks spotlit against darkness.

pairs.difference: B: the background is one flat mid grey, the same value as the ball's edge, so the ball is not separated by value. Inside the ball, a hard light and dark swirl breaks it up. Contrast (0.109) is just under the real range. A: the glass is a clear light mass on darker purple, with a stepped diamond pattern. Its gap (0.257) runs high, so this is a weak call.
pairs.fix: Darken the sides of the ball with a soft rim so it reads as one round form. Quiet the swirl to gentle light steps, and lighten the background slightly behind the ball.

pairs.difference: A: the cat is a huge solid-black silhouette on a light background, with almost no middle values inside the body. Only the eyes and whiskers break it up. Contrast (0.236) and gap (-0.451) are far outside the real range. B: everything is high key and pale, slightly too light at 0.783, but the fountain has soft stepped form and no extreme dark mass.
pairs.fix: Paint the cat in soft dark grey fur, with broad lighter areas on the head, chest and back. Fade gradually into shadow, and keep true black only for the pupils and the contact shadow.

pairs.difference: A: the house is split into many busy dark-to-white patches, with near-white windows punched into dark walls and black roof edges. A pale ring sits around the moon, and the gap of -0.217 is past the real limit. B: the lighthouse has broad simple bands, mid sky, white clouds and a calm dark band on the tower, matching the real lighthouse in the lessons.
pairs.fix: Group the walls and roof into two or three simple value shapes. Lighten the roof shadows, dim the window glow so it does not reach pure white, and remove the pale ring around the moon.

pairs.difference: A: the coffin is a flat dark mass on mid-grey grass, and the light sky and corners run against a real card's darkening edge (vignette -0.071, at the limit). The gap of -0.199 is just past the real limit. Inside the lid the value barely changes, except for a hard black slot where it opens. B: the white table top is a clear light shape against mid grass, with dark accents in the cast shadows and tree.
pairs.fix: Lighten the coffin lid with a soft fade across the wood and a brighter top face. Lower the sky brightness slightly, and make the opening a deep brown rather than a black slot.

pairs.difference: A: the card is washed out and very light (0.807), with a white halo around the stone merging into the white floor. The stone itself has blotchy pale greys and hardly any dark accents. B: also light (0.762), but the shoes carry firm dark mesh and shadows, and the contrast (0.159) is well within the real range. The edge between wall and floor is clean, with no glow around the shoes.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright glow behind the tombstone and darken the floor and wall to a mid value. Give the stone a clear shadow side and a darker cross recess so it stands apart from the background.

pairs.difference: A: near-white glowing eyes and mouth are cut hard into a mid-value pumpkin, creating the brightest and sharpest shapes inside the hero. The floor is streaky mid grey. B: the duck has broad smooth light shapes and sits on dark rays, with its black spots limited to the eye and spring. B's contrast is slightly low (0.116). All measures are close, so this is a weak call.
pairs.fix: Dim the inside of the carved face to a warm middle yellow with a soft fade at the edges, so it no longer reads as white against the pumpkin.

pairs.difference: A: the balloons form mid to dark soft shapes on a mid sky with white clouds at the bottom, and small highlights. B: the buoy is a dark mid mass among white clouds and rippled water, with a controlled glow on the bell. All four measures on both cards are inside the real range, and the grouping is clear on each.

pattern: Generated cards push value to extremes: dark heroes collapse into solid black masses with few middle steps, and light or glowing parts jump straight to near-white. The result is a contrast and hero-background gap beyond real cards. They also add bright halos around the hero, or wash the whole card too light or too dark, and scatter busy high-contrast patches inside the hero. Real cards keep broad simple groups, soft fades into shadow, and small, well-placed dark accents.
